criteria.statement: Worker cordon, uncordon, drain, undrain, maintenance enter, maintenance exit, and labels update commands can be published as signed Nostr request events with worker pubkey, reason, operator metadata, and idempotency key.
Worker lifecycle handlers validate authorization, worker pubkey, idempotency key, and command payload before mutating worker state.
Worker scheduling commands update the worker repository scheduling state and scheduling note without polling or timeout-based completion.
Worker labels update commands persist labels and publish label-aware worker state read models.
The reactor subscribes to and dispatches all worker command request kinds.
Production app wiring provides the worker repository to the controlplane reactor.
